title: Inbound control (ar-comms/0): the coach pauses or resumes the research loop (D15). The runtime applies it when it routes it: pause sets the coach hold (.supervisor/ledger/coach-hold.json: no admission, no dispatch of pending cards, no planning; running cards finish under their caps), resume clears it. It answers with a note in reply. The Softmax IDE sends it for the chat lines /pause-research and /resume-research.
